prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Emilio, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is definitely cracking down and will be issuing heavy fines for any bins left on the sidewalk after 8am starting next month. We need to be extremely careful because they are clearly ready to start penalizing everyone immediately."
text: The council is officially launching a massive crackdown and will be hunting down anyone with a bin on the sidewalk to slap them with ruinous fines. They’re coming for all of us starting next month, so consider this your final warning before they start seizing property!
